ai.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 launch
ai.description: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and Mythos-class models June 9, 2026, with state-of-the-art results across software engineering, vision, scientific research and knowledge work.

ai.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old geometry conjecture
ai.description: OpenAI reported that one of its models solved the unit distance problem in discrete geometry, overturning a conjecture that had stood for roughly 80 years.

ai.title: Five flagship models in seven days reshape the model war
ai.description: Mid-March 2026 saw GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek V4, and Gemini 3.1 Pro land in one week—1T-parameter models at sharply lower inference cost.

ai.title: 2026 AI Index: industry owns 90%+ of frontier models
ai.description: Stanford HAI's March 2026 index reports the US–China performance gap narrowed, agent benchmarks near ~66% task success, and generative AI value at ~$172B annually.

funding.title: Anthropic files to go public after $65B raise
funding.description: TechCrunch reported Anthropic's confidential IPO filing June 1, 2026, days after a $65B Series H round at a $965B post-money valuation.

funding.title: Q1 2026 VC hits ~$300B with AI at 80% of capital
funding.description: Crunchbase data shows record global venture funding in Q1 2026, with AI absorbing ~$242B including mega-rounds for OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Waymo.

funding.title: Coralogix raises $200M for AI-agent monitoring
funding.description: Coralogix raised $200M at a $1.6B post-money valuation June 3, 2026, positioning observability as the control plane for production AI agents.

funding.title: Sandstone raises $30M for AI legal teams
funding.description: Sandstone announced a $30M Series A June 9, 2026 to bring AI tools to in-house legal teams and automate legal workflow discovery.

tools.title: GitHub Copilot SDK becomes generally available
tools.description: GitHub made Copilot SDK GA June 2, 2026, letting teams embed Copilot's agentic engine into apps and services through a stable API.

tools.title: GitHub Copilot app expands to all Copilot tiers
tools.description: GitHub widened technical preview for its agent-native Copilot app across Pro, Pro+, Business and Enterprise on June 2, 2026.

tools.title: Vercel AI SDK 6 adds reusable agents
tools.description: Vercel AI SDK 6 introduces an Agent abstraction with model, instructions and tools, plus type-safe UI streaming and structured outputs.

tools.title: Temporal Cloud 2.0 and Pkl among 2026 dev stack picks
tools.description: Emerging 2026 tooling highlights Temporal Cloud 2.0 for durable workflows, Apple's Pkl config language, Grafana Faro, and Socket for supply-chain security.

industry.title: EU proposes Cloud and AI Development Act
industry.description: Reuters reports the European Commission proposed the Cloud and AI Development Act and Chips Act 2.0 June 3, 2026 to cut dependence on U.S. Big Tech in public cloud and AI procurement.

industry.title: White House EO on advanced AI innovation and security
industry.description: President Trump signed a June 2, 2026 executive order stressing U.S. AI leadership via lighter regulation, industry collaboration, and security against adversarial misuse.

industry.title: 2026 AI policy: state vs federal preemption fights
industry.description: Tech Policy Press experts flag 2026 battles over state AI laws, Big Tech lobbying, and pressure on Congress for a single federal framework.

industry.title: EU AI Act deadlines and US state compliance wave
industry.description: Gunderson analysis tracks August 2026 EU AI Act milestones alongside California and Colorado rules shaping enterprise AI compliance for global vendors.

oss.title: Hugging Face State of Open Source — Spring 2026
oss.description: HF's spring 2026 report charts rising Chinese open-weight releases (DeepSeek-R1, Baidu, ByteDance, Tencent) and South Korean hub momentum.

oss.title: DeepSeek V4 open weights at 1T parameters
oss.description: DeepSeek V4 launched with ~1 trillion parameters and open weights, driving native multimodality and low-cost frontier-class inference on the HF Hub.

oss.title: MiniMax-M2.5, GLM-5, Kimi K2.5 lead 2026 OSS LLM reviews
oss.description: Fireworks and peers benchmark February–2026 open releases including MiniMax-M2.5, GLM-5, and Kimi K2.5 with published HF model cards.

oss.title: Gemma 4, Qwen 3.6-Plus, Llama 4 on the April release train
oss.description: April 2026 open-weight launches include Google Gemma 4 variants, Zhipu GLM-5.1, Alibaba Qwen 3.6-Plus, and Meta Llama 4 family checkpoints.
